basic_info.description: Modern comfort and convenience at Oceanview Village! Built in 2002, this spacious 1 bedroom, 1 bath condo offers a bright and open floor plan and a office/den area with wood floors, and large double-paned windows. The modern kitchen features granite countertops, appliances, and ample cabinetry. Enjoy in-unit laundry, generous storage with multiple closets, and 1 deeded parking space in a secure garage. Located above H-Mart, Chase Bank, and popular eateries, just minutes to Daly City BART, SFSU, Stonestown, Westlake, and Serramonte shopping centers. Easy access to Hwy 280 for a convenient commute. A perfect blend of style, comfort, and location—move-in ready!
